name: Ads that bring in buyers
tagline: Not just cheap clicks: messaging built around your customer’s objections.

gallery.title: 8 ads, 2 campaigns, the same audience
gallery.lead: For real estate agency owners: a free lead magnet to capture leads and an in-person immersion for those ready to buy. Each piece tackles a different objection. Ads in Portuguese.
facts: Real estate agency owners and managers
Funnel X-Ray Kit and the High-Performance Leader immersion
gallery.waMessage: Hi Diogo, I saw the Guilherme Machado ads on your website and I’d like ads like those

items.angle: Authority and the material in hand
items.text: Opens with Guilherme and the name of the talk his audience already knows, and shows the kit laid out: checklist, calculator, objection map and 30-day plan. People see what they’ll get before they click.

items.angle: The math that changes the question
items.text: 1.15 multiplied five times equals 2.01. Improving each stage by 15% doubles sales without buying a single extra lead. The piece moves owners away from the idea that the problem is a lack of leads.

items.angle: The scene every owner has seen
items.text: A WhatsApp conversation where the property viewing falls apart in front of the reader. It shows one concrete agent mistake and promises the other four funnel points inside the kit.

items.product: High-Performance Leader immersion (2 days, in person in São Paulo)
items.text: Starts with a compliment and flips it: if the owner is the best salesperson, the company depends on them. It speaks to owners who still sell at the front desk and presents the immersion as the way out.

items.product: High-Performance Leader immersion (2 days, in person in São Paulo)
items.text: Sets the immersion apart from yet another motivational event by showing what you take home: the 60-day action plan and 20+ tools to use with the team.

items.product: High-Performance Leader immersion (2 days, in person in São Paulo)
items.text: Puts the doubt that stalls sign-ups on screen, “how can I step away for 2 days?”, and answers in Guilherme’s tone: if you can’t step away, the operation already depends on you too much.

items.product: High-Performance Leader immersion (2 days, in person in São Paulo)
items.text: Uses the cohort date as a real deadline: whoever starts organizing the team in January is already late. Last cohort of the year, with applications at the earliest price tier.

items.product: High-Performance Leader immersion (2 days, in person in São Paulo)
items.text: October cohort piece. It lists the content (funnel, forecast, CRM, rituals, 1:1s, cadence) to show it’s 2 days of method, with the date and city right in the ad.
